name: Ohio
agency: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft

rule.hpNote: boat powered by more than 10 hp (PWC included)
rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1982 needs proof of boater education (approved course or state proficiency exam) to run a boat over 10 hp, PWC included.
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1982 o después necesita comprobar su educación náutica (curso aprobado o examen de competencia del estado) para manejar una embarcación de más de 10 hp, incluidas las motos acuáticas.

minAge.note: Boats over 10 hp: under 12 only with an adult 18+ on board, both certified if born 1982 or later; alone from 12 with a certificate. PWC: none under 12; 12-15 with an adult 18+ on board; alone from 16 with a certificate.

exemptions: Holders of a valid U.S. Coast Guard merchant mariner credential with a master or operator endorsement (carry it on board).

card.feeNote: The ODNR proficiency exam at a Watercraft Office is free; course providers set their own prices. Replacement cards for online courses via ilostmycard.com.

nonResident: Ohio accepts any NASBLA-approved certificate or card from another state or U.S. territory showing name, address and date of birth.
rental: Renters born on or after Jan. 1, 1982 of boats over 10 hp must sign that they hold a certificate or pass a short exam (90%+) given by the rental business, valid for that rental only.
pwcExtra: PWC: ages 12-15 only with an adult 18+ on board (adult also certified if born 1982 or later); from 16 alone with a certificate.
penalty: Fourth-degree misdemeanor: up to $250 and/or 30 days; up to $500 and/or 60 days if linked to a collision, injury or damage.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Ohio law requires boaters born on or after January 1, 1982, to successfully complete either a boating course or a proficiency exam in order to operate a boat powered by more than 10 horsepower.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Children under 12 may not operate a PWC, not even with an education certificate.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Children 12 to 15 can operate a PWC as long as they are under the direct supervision of an adult (18 or older) who is onboard

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Children 16 or older can operate a PWC as long as they have an education certificate. Adult supervision is not required.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Children 12 and over may operate any other type of powerboat greater than 10HP as long as they have an education certificate.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: must produce a certificate of completion of either an approved course or proficiency test not later than 72 hours after being stopped.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Successfully passes an abbreviated exam, with a score of 90 percent or better, administered by the business and valid only for the period of the rental agreement.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: punishable by a fine of not more than $250, a term of imprisonment of not more than 30 days, or both.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Individuals who possess valid merchant mariner credentials issued by the US Coast Guard with at least one endorsement of master or operator are exempt

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: Ohio will accept any certificate or card (including those from another state or U.S. territory)

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: There is no fee to take a proficiency exam.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: A temporary or permanent certificate is available immediately to download or print upon completion of an on-line course.

sources.publisher: Ohio Department of Natural Resources, Division of Parks and Watercraft
sources.quote: You can order a replacement or updated card for on-line courses through www.ilostmycard.com
